name: @lacspace/patterns
description: Rule-based chart-pattern detection on OHLCV bars: ATR-sized swings (zigzag), harmonic XABCD patterns (Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, Crab, Cypher, AB=CD) with potential-reversal zones, an Elliott impulse count that obeys the three hard rules, classic chart patterns (double tops/bottoms, head & shoulders, triangles, wedges, channels, ranges) with necklines and measured moves, per-session TPO market profiles and volume profiles, and Kagi / Point & Figure transforms. Drawing-ready paths and zones plus plain data. Descriptive geometry, never a forecast. Zero-dependency.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
